segments.text: Legends of the Kethaneum are whispered. Not from fear, but because some truths resist loud telling. Awe needs no fanfare. The Kethaneum-that vast, cosmic repository-exists at the edges of space, time, and understanding. There knowledge becomes something more than information.

To cross its threshold is to step between what is known and what yearns to be found. It is the cosmos given structure. Understanding as architecture. Infinity folds into halls. Starlight crystallizes into shelves that hold not just books, but windows of possibility. Here, knowledge lives. It hums in the air like a half-remembered song. It grows like a beloved garden. Here no story is just a story and all of them are waiting for those who understand how to listen.

This library does not merely store, it remembers. What is entrusted here is held in patterns that shimmer and shift. Knowledge here responds to intention and care. Touch a book with genuine curiosity, and you may feel the book reach back.

Those who walk these halls speak of a presence difficult to name. Not watchfulness, exactly. More like... being held within an ancient awareness, patient as the formation of galaxies and vast as the void. 

However, to all who seek it, they know that to serve the Kethaneum is to serve all futures that might yet unfold. 

What is stored there is stored for the benefit of ages. What is shaped within these walls ripples outward like light through water. All is connected through the lines of story touching realms unseen, lives distant, and histories great and small.

But no matter how many stories and histories are stored within, the Kethaneum remembers...
